Nisha (AcmeCorp): Heads-up: since the canary yesterday we're seeing a bunch of Spanish/Hindi requests returned in English. Hit staging first, then prod. Example: user asked "¿Cuál es el horario de atención?" and got "Our business hours are..." (English). Not errors, just wrong language.
Priya (CSE): Sorry — that's rough. Can you paste: 1) model + version, 2) exact request body (sanitized), 3) response request_id/header, and 4) any locale hints you set (Accept-Language or system message)?
Nisha (AcmeCorp): model: redwood-instruct-3.1, endpoint /v1/chat/completions, request_id: req_0b7e9d. Sample body (sanitized):
```
{
  "model": "redwood-instruct-3.1",
  "messages": [{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Traduce al español: ¿Cuál es el horario de atención?"}],
  "max_tokens": 80
}
```
No Accept-Language header. Started right after canary/2026-12-03 (deploy-bot posted rollout).
deploy-bot: Rollout canary/2026-12-03-17:22 started -> service: inference, models: redwood-instruct-3.1
Jordan (Support): Thanks. Quick checks: do you ever override system prompt in prod? streaming vs non-streaming? Could be a prompt-format/seq-length regression.
Nisha (AcmeCorp): sometimes we prepend user_locale=es to system prompt but not in this repro. Non-streaming.
Kai (Eng-ML): pinging in. Two working hypotheses: 1) tokenizer tweak in canary that collapses certain multilingual anchors -> increased English bias on very short prompts; 2) routing/fallback is selecting an English-primed variant for short requests. Can you run the curl below and paste response headers (X-Request-ID, X-Model-Instance) + body?
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-instruct-3.1","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Traduce al español: ¿Cuál es el horario de atención?"}],"max_tokens":80}'
```
Kai (Eng-ML): If you see a header like `X-Model-Instance: redwood-instruct-3.1-eng-pool-canary` that's a smoking gun.
Ana (Eng-Infra): also FYI infra had a routing tweak in canary to favor lower-latency pooled variants for small requests. Might be related. We can force-route customers to stable pools while this is investigated.
Nisha (AcmeCorp): here's the actual response returned from prod for the curl:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Request-ID: req_0b7e9d
X-Model-Instance: redwood-instruct-3.1-canary-pool-7
Content-Type: application/json

{"id":"chatcmpl-...","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"Our business hours are 9am-5pm PST, Monday through Friday."}}]}
```
Jordan (Support): that X-Model-Instance does look like a canary pool. Nisha — can you try a temporary workaround: add an explicit system instruction `Responde en español` or `You must reply in Spanish` and see if that forces Spanish?
Nisha (AcmeCorp): adding `Responde en español` returns Spanish correctly for this prompt. But can't ship that as a global fix.
Kai (Eng-ML): short repro notes: the canary includes a small tokenizer merge that reduces distinctiveness of some language keywords when prompts are <=10 tokens. For short prompts the model drifts to English more often. I ran a quick check across ~2k Spanish/Hindi short prompts: ~14% relative drop in language fidelity for <=10-token user prompts. Longer prompts are fine.
Ana (Eng-Infra): mitigation options: 1) immediate routing override to stable pool for affected accounts, 2) revert tokenizer change in canary, 3) update scoring to prefer language-aware variants when keywords (`Traduce`, `Translate`, `Responde`) are present. We can apply route override quickly.
Priya (CSE): customer asked for ETA. What's realistic?
Kai (Eng-ML): immediate: route override (hours). Medium: revert or patch scoring (1-2 days). Full: re-run canary with targeted lang fidelity tests then redeploy (3-5 days).
Ana (Eng-Infra): routing override scheduling: 1802346100 UTC (will post when applied). Ask Nisha to DM account id.
Nisha (AcmeCorp): DM sent with account id. Thank you. Also flagged to product — they want lang-fidelity gating on any tokenizer or routing changes.
Jordan (Support): action items:
- [Ana] apply route override for AcmeCorp -> stable pool (after DM)
- [Kai] finish regression run, share failing prompts & metrics
- [Priya] keep customer updated; confirm temporary system-prompt workaround works across their flows
- [Release] add language fidelity checks to canary gating for tokenizer/routing patches
Kai (Eng-ML): uploading preliminary failing prompts to internal S3 link: https://internal.redwood.ai/s3/regressions/2026-12-shortprompt-lang-failures (internal).
